The details

Three barriers break the chain

01

Weak detection in white zones

Unconscious victims, zero 4G coverage — nobody knows.

02

Blind evaluation

Units dispatched without victim count, entrapment or true severity.

03

Blind orientation

Nearest hospital ≠ right hospital: missing specialty means a deadly second transfer.

In these cases, victims need Awn.
